source_notes: Case 2 P41-16; source block B3.1 (browser block 16). The source publication reports a right hemisphere and no incidental findings for this case.
Structures show their delivered extent within block B3.1. Block-edge surfaces mark the limits of this tissue sample.
Native source samples and affine geometry are retained. Surface display uses the categorical boundary at half-voxel level.
